sources.title: Brand Build Guide: [26.7] Bizzleberry's Season 2025 Brand Support

passive.name: Blaze
passive.text: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

spells.name: Sear
spells.text: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.

spells.name: Pillar of Flame
spells.text: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take an additional 25% damage.

spells.name: Conflagration
spells.text: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.

spells.name: Pyroclasm
spells.text: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces up to 5 times off of Brand and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage to enemies each time bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on Champions. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will briefly slow them.

damage.value: Brand deals sustained magic damage through ticking Blaze procs and can deal heavy area damage in teamfights.

archetype.value: Brand is a skillshot-based damage support who also provides a stun and, with Rylai's Crystal Scepter, area slows.

axis.value: Brand can poke with ranged spells before stacking Blaze for a detonation.

winCondition.value: Brand wins fights by landing his spells for multiple Blaze procs while stunning threats that move in.

spikes.why: Brand's ticking Blaze can then apply massive area slows.
